title: Search and rescue survivor family honors Coast Guard rescue crews
description: Coast Guard crews from Air Station Clearwater, Station Mayport, the cutter Coho,  were invited to a search and rescue survivor reunion with Charles Gregory, Sept. 21, 2023, St. Augustine, Florida. The family honored the men and women who rescued their son 12 miles offshore of St. Augustine, Aug. 5, 2023.
